columns.name: whatsapp
columns.label: WhatsApp number
columns.help: International format, e.g. +971501234567. Visitors tap a button that opens WhatsApp with this number.

columns.name: legal_name
columns.label: Legal name
columns.help: The company name on your trade licence.

columns.name: office_reg_label
columns.label: Office registration label
columns.help: What your office number is called, e.g. ORN (Dubai, RERA) or ADREC licence (Abu Dhabi).

columns.name: office_reg_value
columns.label: Office registration number
columns.help: Shown in the footer and on every listing page. Check the current rules of your emirate for what adverts must show.

columns.name: hide_without_permit
columns.label: Hide listings without a permit number
columns.help: On: a listing with an empty permit number is never shown to visitors. Dubai adverts need a permit number; check the current rules of your emirate before turning this off.

columns.name: phone
columns.help: International format, e.g. +971501234567.

columns.name: whatsapp
columns.label: WhatsApp number
columns.help: Leave empty to use the agency's WhatsApp number.

columns.name: brn
columns.label: Broker number (BRN)
columns.help: The agent's broker registration number, shown on their listings. Check the current rules of your emirate.

columns.name: languages
columns.label: Languages
columns.help: For example: English, Arabic, Hindi.

columns.name: status
columns.label: Status
columns.help: Visitors see only available and reserved listings. Use hidden for a draft.

columns.name: handover
columns.label: Handover (off-plan)
columns.help: For example: Q4 2028.

columns.name: price
columns.label: Price (AED)
columns.help: Sale price, or the rent for the period below.

columns.name: rent_period
columns.label: Rent period
columns.help: Only for rentals.

columns.name: bedrooms
columns.label: Bedrooms
columns.help: 0 for a studio. Leave empty for offices, shops and land.

columns.name: community
columns.label: Community
columns.help: For example Dubai Marina. Write it the same way on every listing: visitors filter by it.

columns.name: amenities
columns.label: Amenities
columns.help: Separated by commas, e.g. Pool, Gym, Covered parking.

columns.name: permit_number
columns.label: Permit number
columns.help: The advertising permit number of this advert (Trakheesi in Dubai, ADREC in Abu Dhabi). Dubai adverts need a permit number; check the current rules of your emirate. Without it the listing is not shown on the site while "Hide listings without a permit number" is on.

columns.name: permit_qr
columns.label: Permit QR code
columns.help: Upload the QR code image issued with the permit; it is shown next to the permit number.

columns.name: reference
columns.label: Reference
columns.help: Your own code, e.g. MH-1001. Visitors quote it on WhatsApp.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.label: Agent
columns.help: The # of the agent in Agents.

columns.name: map_url
columns.label: Map link
columns.help: A link to the location on Google Maps, starting with https://.

columns.name: published
columns.label: Published
columns.help: Used for "newest first" and for the reminder about listings older than 60 days.

columns.name: listing_id
columns.label: Listing
columns.help: The # of the listing in Listings; empty for a general enquiry.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.label: Agent
columns.help: The # of the agent in Agents.

columns.name: source
columns.label: Page
columns.help: The page the form was sent from.

columns.name: status
columns.label: Status
columns.help: Change it as you follow up. Leads still new after 24 hours are listed in the daily email.

columns.name: notes
columns.label: Notes
columns.help: Only you see these.

texts.en: Selling or renting out your property? Tell us about it and we will call you with a free valuation.
texts.ar: تريد بيع أو تأجير عقارك؟ أخبرنا عنه وسنتصل بك لتقييم مجاني.

texts.en: No properties match your search right now. Tell us what you are looking for and we will find it.
texts.ar: لا توجد عقارات مطابقة لبحثك حالياً. أخبرنا بما تبحث عنه وسنجده لك.

texts.en: We use your details only to answer this request.
texts.ar: نستخدم بياناتك فقط للرد على هذا الطلب.

texts.en: Please fill in your name, a valid mobile number and your message.
texts.ar: يرجى إدخال الاسم ورقم جوال صحيح والرسالة.

texts.en: Please choose a viewing date from today onwards.
texts.ar: يرجى اختيار تاريخ للمعاينة من اليوم فصاعداً.

texts.en: We received your viewing request. An agent will call you to confirm the time.
texts.ar: استلمنا طلب المعاينة. سيتصل بك أحد وكلائنا لتأكيد الموعد.

texts.en: We received your message and will get back to you shortly.
We received your request and will call you shortly.
We received your request. An agent will call you about the valuation.
texts.ar: استلمنا طلبك. سيتصل بك أحد وكلائنا بخصوص التقييم.

texts.en: We could not take another request right now. Please contact us on WhatsApp or call us and we will help you straight away.
texts.ar: لا يمكننا استلام طلب آخر الآن. يرجى التواصل معنا على واتساب أو الاتصال بنا وسنساعدك فوراً.

Returns price in AED (rent per year unless rent_period says monthly), reference, advertising permit number and the listing page url, where the visitor can request a viewing or ask a question. Call without arguments to list the newest.
